description: This file defines a custom exception class, SavingsAccountNotFoundException, which extends a platform-specific resource not found exception. It provides constructors for exceptions related to missing savings account IDs or external IDs, indicating that a savings account was not found.

classes.name: SavingsAccountNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a savings account was not found, extended from AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException.

methods.name: SavingsAccountNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with a message indicating the savings account with the given ID does not exist.

methods.name: SavingsAccountNotFoundException(String externalId)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with a message indicating the savings account with the external ID does not exist.

methods.name: SavingsAccountNotFoundException(Long id, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with a message and an underlying cause when a data access exception occurs for the given ID.
